title: 국립공업고등학교 설치령 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Establishment, etc.)
(1) The Minister of SMEs and Startups shall, upon entrustment by the Minister of Education pursuant to Article 62 (2) of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act, establish and operate Gumi Electronics Technical High School, Busan Mechanical Technical High School, and Jeonbuk Mechanical Technical High School (hereinafter referred to as "national technical high schools") to provide systematic education concerning technologies and skills required in industrial settings and to develop specialized human resources. [Amended on March 23, 2013; July 26, 2017.]
(2) The locations of national technical high schools shall be as specified in the attached Table.
